svg.title: Event management: UX journey, stack layers and feature ownership
svg.desc: Five UX stages run horizontally from discovery through account, checkout, payment decisions, and attendance and reviews. Frontend, backend and database layers run vertically. Olive green identifies feature 1, azure blue identifies feature 2, and paired colours identify a shared contract. Supporting flows include event setup, profiles, rewards, organizer statistics, emails and timeout processing.
svg.text: One journey across both features — each builder owns frontend and backend work.
Identity → checkout Rewards ↔ purchase Decisions → status Attendance → review
Events, ticket types and vouchers; dashboard entry
Feature 1: two-hour proof expiry / three-day decision cancellation. Feature 2: reward service and decision emails.
One SQL transaction updates status, capacity and rewards; retries restore applicable resources once.
Rp0 checkout: confirm without proof or payment review. Registration is separate from attendance.
Planned map · some APIs/data remain fixtures · detailed UX defaults and technical contracts stay open to input.
